reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web settings panel for managing the runtime and persisted enablement state of non-core third-party plugins.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页面中查看并启用或禁用非核心第三方插件。
summaries.en: Manage the runtime and persisted enablement state of non-core third-party plugins from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings page.

capabilities: Enables or disables non-core third-party plugins in the host process
Persists plugin enablement state to the current Web Profile configuration
Performs local write operations through the host RPC interface
